```{r}
#Environment and Global Settings


library(hdrm)
library(glmnet)
library(MASS)
library(future.apply)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
library(scales)

set.seed(12345)


#Simulation Settings


nsim <- 2500

n_values <- c(250, 500)
rho_values <- c(0, 0.35, 0.70)

p <- 20
p_nonzero <- 5

v_names <- paste0("V", sprintf("%02d", 1:p))

true_betas <- c(0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5) / 3
beta_true <- c(true_betas, rep(0, p - p_nonzero))

true_vars <- v_names[1:p_nonzero]
null_vars <- v_names[(p_nonzero + 1):p]

alpha_level <- 0.05

alpha_lasso <- 1
alpha_enet <- 0.5
nfolds_glmnet <- 5

run_label <- paste0("nsim_", nsim, "_cv", nfolds_glmnet)

output_path <- "C:/Users/kokeshem/Spring 2026/Advanced Statistical Methods/Project 4/Project 4 output"

if (!dir.exists(output_path)) {
  dir.create(output_path, recursive = TRUE)
}
```


```{r}

#Backward selection using p-value cutoff


back_select_pvalue <- function(dat, vars, outcome = "y", alpha_cutoff = 0.05) {
  
  current_vars <- vars
  
  repeat {
    
    if (length(current_vars) == 0) break
    
    form <- as.formula(
      paste(outcome, "~", paste(current_vars, collapse = " + "))
    )
    
    fit <- lm(form, data = dat)
    coef_table <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    
    if (nrow(coef_table) <= 1) break
    
    pvals <- coef_table[-1, "Pr(>|t|)", drop = TRUE]
    max_p <- max(pvals, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (max_p > alpha_cutoff) {
      drop_var <- names(which.max(pvals))
      current_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, drop_var)
    } else {
      break
    }
  }
  
  current_vars
}


#Backward selection using actual AIC or BIC


back_select_ic <- function(dat, vars, outcome = "y", criterion = c("AIC", "BIC")) {
  
  criterion <- match.arg(criterion)
  current_vars <- vars
  
  get_ic <- function(fit) {
    if (criterion == "AIC") {
      AIC(fit)
    } else {
      BIC(fit)
    }
  }
  
  repeat {
    
    if (length(current_vars) == 0) break
    
    current_form <- as.formula(
      paste(outcome, "~", paste(current_vars, collapse = " + "))
    )
    
    current_fit <- lm(current_form, data = dat)
    current_ic <- get_ic(current_fit)
    
    candidate_results <- purrr::map_dfr(current_vars, function(drop_var) {
      
      candidate_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, drop_var)
      
      if (length(candidate_vars) == 0) {
        candidate_form <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ 1"))
      } else {
        candidate_form <- as.formula(
          paste(outcome, "~", paste(candidate_vars, collapse = " + "))
        )
      }
      
      candidate_fit <- lm(candidate_form, data = dat)
      
      tibble(
        drop_var = drop_var,
        candidate_ic = get_ic(candidate_fit)
      )
    })
    
    best_candidate <- candidate_results %>%
      arrange(candidate_ic) %>%
      slice(1)
    
    if (best_candidate$candidate_ic < current_ic) {
      current_vars <- setdiff(current_vars, best_candidate$drop_var)
    } else {
      break
    }
  }
  
  current_vars
}
```

```{r}

#Extract selected variables from cv.glmnet


get_glmnet_selected_vars <- function(cv_obj, lambda_choice) {
  
  coef_mat <- as.matrix(coef(cv_obj, s = lambda_choice))
  selected_vars <- rownames(coef_mat)[coef_mat[, 1] != 0]
  selected_vars <- setdiff(selected_vars, "(Intercept)")
  
  selected_vars
}


#Calculate variable-level metrics after selection


calculate_metrics <- function(selected_vars, sim_X, sim_y, true_beta) {
  
  results <- tibble(
    var = v_names,
    selected = as.numeric(v_names %in% selected_vars),
    estimate = NA_real_,
    covered_selected = NA_real_,
    significant = 0
  )
  
  if (length(selected_vars) > 0) {
    
    dat_refit <- data.frame(sim_X, y = sim_y)
    colnames(dat_refit)[1:p] <- v_names
    
    form <- as.formula(
      paste("y ~", paste(selected_vars, collapse = " + "))
    )
    
    fit <- lm(form, data = dat_refit)
    sum_fit <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    
    ci <- tryCatch(
      confint(fit, level = 0.95),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    
    for (v in selected_vars) {
      
      idx <- which(results$var == v)
      
      if (v %in% rownames(sum_fit)) {
        
        results$estimate[idx] <- sum_fit[v, "Estimate"]
        
        results$significant[idx] <- as.numeric(
          sum_fit[v, "Pr(>|t|)"] < alpha_level
        )
        
        if (!is.null(ci) && v %in% rownames(ci)) {
          results$covered_selected[idx] <- as.numeric(
            ci[v, 1] <= true_beta[idx] & ci[v, 2] >= true_beta[idx]
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  results
}
```

```{r}
#Core Simulation Function


run_single_iteration <- function(iteration_id, n, rho) {
  
  sim <- gen_data(
    n,
    p,
    p_nonzero,
    beta_true,
    corr = "exchangeable",
    rho = rho
  )
  
  X_mat <- as.matrix(sim$X)
  colnames(X_mat) <- v_names
  
  y_vec <- as.numeric(sim$y)
  
  dat <- data.frame(X_mat, y = y_vec)
  
  methods <- list(
    Back_05 = back_select_pvalue(
      dat = dat,
      vars = v_names,
      outcome = "y",
      alpha_cutoff = 0.05
    ),
    
    AIC = back_select_ic(
      dat = dat,
      vars = v_names,
      outcome = "y",
      criterion = "AIC"
    ),
    
    BIC = back_select_ic(
      dat = dat,
      vars = v_names,
      outcome = "y",
      criterion = "BIC"
    )
  )
  
  cv_lasso <- cv.glmnet(
    x = X_mat,
    y = y_vec,
    alpha = alpha_lasso,
    nfolds = nfolds_glmnet,
    standardize = TRUE
  )
  
  cv_enet <- cv.glmnet(
    x = X_mat,
    y = y_vec,
    alpha = alpha_enet,
    nfolds = nfolds_glmnet,
    standardize = TRUE
  )
  
  methods$Lasso_min <- get_glmnet_selected_vars(cv_lasso, "lambda.min")
  methods$Lasso_1se <- get_glmnet_selected_vars(cv_lasso, "lambda.1se")
  methods$ENet_min  <- get_glmnet_selected_vars(cv_enet, "lambda.min")
  methods$ENet_1se  <- get_glmnet_selected_vars(cv_enet, "lambda.1se")
  
  bind_rows(lapply(names(methods), function(method_name) {
    
    calculate_metrics(
      selected_vars = methods[[method_name]],
      sim_X = X_mat,
      sim_y = y_vec,
      true_beta = beta_true
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        method = method_name,
        iteration_id = iteration_id,
        N = n,
        Rho = rho
      )
  }))
}
```

```{r}

#Main Execution: Parallel Loop by Scenario


scenarios <- expand_grid(
  N = n_values,
  Rho = rho_values
)

all_results <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(scenarios))) {
  
  n_val <- scenarios$N[i]
  rho_val <- scenarios$Rho[i]
  
  message(
    sprintf(
      "Running scenario %d of %d: N = %d, Rho = %.2f",
      i, nrow(scenarios), n_val, rho_val
    )
  )
  
  plan(multisession, workers = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1))
  
  scenario_results <- future_lapply(
    X = seq_len(nsim),
    FUN = run_single_iteration,
    n = n_val,
    rho = rho_val,
    future.seed = TRUE
  )
  
  all_results[[i]] <- bind_rows(scenario_results)
  
  save(
    scenario_results,
    file = file.path(
      output_path,
      paste0("Project4_scenario_results_", run_label, "_N", n_val, "_rho", rho_val, ".RData")
    )
  )
  
  plan(sequential)
  gc()
}

full_simulation_results <- bind_rows(all_results)

save(
  full_simulation_results,
  file = file.path(output_path, paste0("Project4_Final_Results_", run_label, ".RData"))
)

write_csv(
  full_simulation_results,
  file = file.path(output_path, paste0("Project4_Final_Results_", run_label, ".csv"))
)

message("Full simulation results saved to: ", output_path)
```

```{r}
#Create labels and analysis dataset for tables

method_order <- c(
  "Back_05", "AIC", "BIC",
  "Lasso_min", "Lasso_1se",
  "ENet_min",  "ENet_1se"
)

method_labels <- c(
  "Back_05"   = "Backward p < 0.05",
  "AIC"       = "Backward AIC",
  "BIC"       = "Backward BIC",
  "Lasso_min" = "Lasso lambda.min",
  "Lasso_1se" = "Lasso lambda.1se",
  "ENet_min"  = "Elastic net lambda.min",
  "ENet_1se"  = "Elastic net lambda.1se"
)

true_betas_map <- tibble(
  var          = v_names,
  true_beta    = beta_true,
  is_true      = beta_true != 0,
  variable_type = if_else(beta_true != 0, "True predictor", "Null predictor")
)

analysis_data <- full_simulation_results %>%
  left_join(true_betas_map, by = "var") %>%
  mutate(
    method       = factor(method, levels = method_order),
    method_label = recode(as.character(method), !!!method_labels),
    method_label = factor(method_label, levels = method_labels[method_order]),

    #Unconditional estimate: unselected set to 0
    estimate_unconditional = if_else(selected == 1, estimate, 0),

    #Bias and squared error (for RMSE)
    bias_unconditional     = estimate_unconditional - true_beta,
    sq_error_unconditional = bias_unconditional^2,

    #selected-only bias as secondary (NA when unselected)
    bias_selected = estimate - true_beta,

    #Unconditional coverage:
    #selected: use the refit CI indicator
    #unselected true: 0 (non-coverage)
    #unselected null: 1 (zero estimate trivially covers zero truth)
    covered_unconditional = case_when(
      selected == 1                 ~ covered_selected,
      selected == 0 & is_true       ~ 0,
      selected == 0 & !is_true      ~ 1,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_real_
    ),

    scenario_label = paste0("N = ", N, ", rho = ", Rho)
  )


#Sanity checks


stopifnot(
  nrow(full_simulation_results) == nsim * length(n_values) *
                                   length(rho_values) * length(method_order) * p
)

#Every cell should have exactly 20 rows
rows_per_cell <- full_simulation_results %>%
  count(N, Rho, method, iteration_id) %>%
  pull(n)
stopifnot(all(rows_per_cell == p))

#Selected variables must have a non-NA estimate
stopifnot(
  full_simulation_results %>%
    filter(selected == 1, is.na(estimate)) %>% nrow() == 0
)

#Iteration-level summary used by Figure 2 and Table 1
iteration_level_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, N, Rho, scenario_label, iteration_id) %>%
  summarise(
    model_size             = sum(selected),
    true_positives         = sum(selected[is_true]),
    false_positives        = sum(selected[!is_true]),
    any_false_positive     = as.numeric(false_positives > 0),
    any_null_significant   = as.numeric(any(significant[!is_true] == 1)),
    perfect_model_recovery = as.numeric(
      true_positives == p_nonzero & false_positives == 0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}

# TABLE 1:Method performance by scenario

table1_data <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, N, Rho, scenario_label) %>%
  summarise(
    tpr                       = mean(selected[is_true]),
    fpr                       = mean(selected[!is_true]),
    type_1_error              = mean(significant[!is_true]),
    type_2_error              = 1 - mean(significant[is_true]),
    coverage_true             = mean(covered_unconditional[is_true], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias_true            = mean(bias_unconditional[is_true],    na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse_true                 = sqrt(mean(sq_error_unconditional[is_true], na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    iteration_level_summary %>%
      group_by(method, method_label, N, Rho, scenario_label) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_model_size             = mean(model_size),
        any_false_positive_rate     = mean(any_false_positive),
        perfect_model_recovery_rate = mean(perfect_model_recovery),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("method", "method_label", "N", "Rho", "scenario_label")
  ) %>%
  arrange(N, Rho, method)

table1_gt <- table1_data %>%
  select(
    scenario_label,
    Method = method_label,
    mean_model_size,
    tpr, fpr,
    mean_bias_true, rmse_true, coverage_true,
    type_1_error, type_2_error,
    any_false_positive_rate,
    perfect_model_recovery_rate
  ) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "scenario_label") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Table 1. Method Performance by Simulation Scenario**")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Method                      = "Method",
    mean_model_size             = "Mean Model Size",
    tpr                         = "TPR",
    fpr                         = "FPR",
    mean_bias_true              = "Mean Bias",
    rmse_true                   = "RMSE",
    coverage_true               = "Coverage",
    type_1_error                = "Type I Error",
    type_2_error                = "Type II Error",
    any_false_positive_rate     = "Any FP",
    perfect_model_recovery_rate = "Perfect Recovery"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(mean_model_size, mean_bias_true, rmse_true),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = mean_model_size,
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_percent(
    columns  = c(tpr, fpr, coverage_true,
                 type_1_error, type_2_error,
                 any_false_positive_rate, perfect_model_recovery_rate),
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Selection",
    columns = c(mean_model_size, tpr, fpr)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Estimation (Unconditional)",
    columns = c(mean_bias_true, rmse_true, coverage_true)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Post-Selection Inference",
    columns = c(type_1_error, type_2_error)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = "Model Recovery",
    columns = c(any_false_positive_rate, perfect_model_recovery_rate)
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "TPR = average proportion of the 5 true predictors selected. FPR = average proportion of the 15 null predictors selected.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c(tpr, fpr))
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "Unselected variables are treated as having coefficient estimate fixed at 0. For true predictors this contributes a -beta_true bias and is counted as non-coverage; for null predictors the zero estimate trivially covers the zero truth.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c(mean_bias_true, rmse_true, coverage_true))
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "For Backward p < 0.05 and BIC, Type I error and FPR coincide by construction because every retained variable is significant at the selection threshold. For Lasso and Elastic net, the two metrics differ because selection uses cross-validated MSE rather than significance.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = type_1_error)
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "Perfect recovery: all 5 true predictors selected AND no null predictors selected.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = perfect_model_recovery_rate)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size  = px(10),
    data_row.padding = px(2)
  )

table1_gt

gtsave(
  table1_gt,
  filename = file.path(output_path,
                       paste0("Table1_method_performance_by_scenario_",
                              run_label, ".html"))
)
write_csv(
  table1_data,
  file = file.path(output_path,
                   paste0("Table1_method_performance_by_scenario_",
                          run_label, ".csv"))
)
```

```{r}

# TABLE 2: True variable bias and coverage in the highest correlation scenario

table2_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(is_true, N == 250, Rho == 0.70) %>%
  group_by(method, method_label, var, true_beta) %>%
  summarise(
    selection_rate = mean(selected),
    mean_beta_hat  = mean(estimate_unconditional, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias      = mean(bias_unconditional,     na.rm = TRUE),
    rmse           = sqrt(mean(sq_error_unconditional, na.rm = TRUE)),
    coverage       = mean(covered_unconditional,  na.rm = TRUE),
    power          = mean(significant),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, true_beta)

table2_gt <- table2_data %>%
  select(
    Method   = method_label,
    Variable = var,
    `True beta` = true_beta,
    selection_rate,
    mean_beta_hat,
    mean_bias,
    rmse,
    coverage,
    power
  ) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Method") %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = md("**Table 2. Per-Variable Bias and Coverage for True Predictors (High Correlation Scenario)**"),
    subtitle = "N = 250, rho = 0.70"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Variable        = "Variable",
    selection_rate  = "Selection Rate",
    mean_beta_hat   = "Mean Beta-Hat",
    mean_bias       = "Mean Bias",
    rmse            = "RMSE",
    coverage        = "Coverage",
    power           = "Power"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(`True beta`, mean_beta_hat, mean_bias, rmse),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt_percent(
    columns  = c(selection_rate, coverage, power),
    decimals = 1
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "Estimates and bias are unconditional: unselected variables contribute beta-hat = 0 and bias = -true_beta.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = c(mean_beta_hat, mean_bias))
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote  = "Coverage counts an unselected true predictor as not covered.",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = coverage)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size  = px(10),
    data_row.padding = px(2)
  )

table2_gt

gtsave(
  table2_gt,
  filename = file.path(output_path,
                       paste0("Table2_per_variable_high_correlation_scenario_",
                              run_label, ".html"))
)
write_csv(
  table2_data,
  file = file.path(output_path,
                   paste0("Table2_per_variable_high_correlation_scenario_",
                          run_label, ".csv"))
)
```
